notes.title: Crowdfunding Completed – Thank You!
notes.content:
【Crowdfunding Completed – Thank You!】


Our crowdfunding campaign for Bless You Again has officially ended on June 30th!

Thanks to incredible support from our Japanese community, we successfully raised over $68,000.

Please note that the campaign was limited to residents of Japan, so unfortunately international fans were not able to contribute directly.

However, your interest and encouragement from around the world mean a great deal to us.

We’re truly grateful to everyone supporting Bless You Again!



The development team will now be working full speed ahead to deliver the best experience possible.

We’ll continue to share updates here and on our X (formerly Twitter) account:



Official X (Twitter): https://x.com/projectlilyBYA



Thank you again, and please look forward to more!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/bab90a3608d880a944a1968226ad4a263025e58c.gif"]

notes.title: Full Voice Acting Achieved & Onward to Costume Additions!
notes.content:
We’re sorry, but this crowdfunding campaign is only available within Japan.




\[Support Our Crowdfunding Campaign!]

There are only 18 days left in our current crowdfunding campaign!

Thanks to your incredible support, we've surpassed 5 million yen in funding — and full voice acting has officially been confirmed!

Thank you so much!

Our next stretch goals are:

At 7.5 million yen: A new dungeon will be added

At 10 million yen: New character costumes will be added

We’re aiming to make the game even more fun and fulfilling to play!

In addition, we’re planning to release an exclusive demo for backers in July!
It’s your chance to be among the first to try the game — so please consider supporting us while there’s still time!

notes.title: Our first gameplay footage is now live!
notes.content:
On May 4th, we showcased our prototype at an indie game event in Japan and had players try out the early demo.
https://x.com/projectlilyBYA/status/1918591363253227540
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/bf6f493253c9e967849aa54a9fce13f27e691f97.png

In this version, they could:
・View the character
・Use melee attacks
・Use magic attacks
・Move and jump

That’s it for now — it's still an early prototype, not yet fully functional.
Even so, we received tons of valuable feedback, and the experience was incredibly helpful!

Today, we'd also like to share the current development roadmap that we presented during the event:

By June 20:
→ Complete a full prototype (with placeholder assets)

By September 30:
→ Complete a playable demo for Steam Next Fest


Here’s what we plan to include in the prototype by June 20:
・Upgrade system 
・Aerial attacks
・Machine gun-style magic
・Grenade-style magic
・Four elemental magic types
・Shift into fire/water/wind/ground mode *
・Boss battle
・Puzzle mechanics
・Improved enemy AI

*{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/4d62e44c1dbf61b0927f651b6bdfa409202c5c68.png

We’ll continue development in this direction, and we also plan to post here more frequently.
Thanks for your continued support!
